token_family_docs.$description: Contrast mode collection, set by the end user; high can also come from the operating system. Modes: low (.ob-contrast-low), standard (the base, no class is applied), high (.ob-contrast-high). Each mode carries the CSS class string the application adds to a container to activate it. low moves every background one step toward the text, the fixed ones too; the darker grey stays and the strong border gets one step stronger. high moves the surfaces one step away from the text and makes text and borders stronger; the fixed backgrounds stay.

selector.$description: low is activated by a class the application adds to the container.
standard is the base contrast mode: no class is applied. It is the first-paint default.
high is activated by a class the application adds to the container.
